About Me

Data storyteller from Tamil Nadu

I'm a B.Sc. Mathematics graduate from Government Arts College, Karur, with a strong foundation in analytical thinking and a deep interest in data work. Currently interning as a Data Analyst at Cybernaut EdTech, where I work with real business datasets daily.

I enjoy the process of taking messy, unstructured data and turning it into something useful — a clean dashboard, a clear report, an insight that actually helps someone make a decision. I work with Power BI, Excel, SQL, and Power Query and have built projects across food delivery, retail, sales, and customer analytics.

I'm actively looking for full-time roles as a Data Analyst, Power BI Developer, or MIS Executive in India. I'm a quick learner, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large datasets.
